title: Not impressed
text: I was not impressed nor was my son with the first toy. We played with it for a while but we only have a small space. So we needed to place the dominos outside or on the kitchen floor. Which wasn’t bad but made for my son getting a little frustrating. Besides that the blocks were very colorful and we like wooden toys. I’d also say the toy is on the young side for my son's maturity level
label: neutral
